mapper.sql: id, user_id, op_type, detail, ip_address, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, op_type, detail, ip_address, created_at FROM admin_operation_log UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, 'LOGIN' AS op_type, CASE WHEN login_status = 1 THEN '登录成功' ELSE CONCAT('登录失败：', IFNULL(fail_reason, '未知')) END AS detail, login_ip AS ip_address, login_time AS created_at FROM sys_login_log ) t
AND op_type = #{operation}
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_operation_log (user_id, op_type, detail, ip_address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{operation}, #{detail}, #{ip})
